description: Health-bar wobble regression: one SELECTED ARMCOM walking a ~920 wu straight diagonal under a pinned camera, on open ground. The oracle is the health bar (which floors the unit pass's sub-pixel anchor) against the selection box (which floors the same anchor from tagpu_native.c) -- both drawn on top of everything, so no tree can occlude either, and they must move on the SAME frames. shootall off and a far CORE keepalive so nothing fights; noshake on so the camera contributes nothing. Drive it with tools/barwobble.sh.
